hero.title: Condition Based Monitoring
hero.tagline: Decision Intelligence at scale to unlock Latent Potential of each Plant
pillars: AI Agents Enable Decision Intelligence at Scale

analytics.d: Checks every reading before it is analysed, so alerts are not raised on bad data.
Breaks each vibration signal into its frequencies, where specific faults leave a recognisable signature.
Learns each machine's normal behaviour and flags when it starts to drift.
Estimates how long a component can keep running, so work can be planned around production.

benefits.d: Higher availability of machines resulting in increased capacity for production.
Early detection cuts downtime, maintenance expenses, and production losses.
Significant cost savings by avoiding expensive repairs and minimizing production losses.
Proactive hazard identification using remote means eliminates on-site data collection.
Automated data collection and AI analysis reduce the need for manual labor, saving costs.

faults: Frequent burning and heating of drive motors

features.d: Detected anomalies are automatically analyzed, generating issue descriptions, severity classification, and recommended corrective actions (e.g., alignment check, bearing inspection, lubrication, balancing). This helps maintenance teams quickly identify root causes and take targeted action.
features.alt: I/O Sense Monitoring Locations screen listing assets by risk level, with faults found and recommended solutions for a crusher drive end and a gearbox input stage

features.d: The system performs continuous FFT spectrum analysis, harmonic detection, envelope analysis, and trend monitoring to identify vibration signatures associated with imbalance, misalignment, looseness, bearing defects, gear wear, cavitation, resonance, and other mechanical faults.
features.alt: I/O Sense asset timeline showing idle, normal and critical states through the day with FFT captures, and an axial acceleration FFT spectrum

specs: Stud is provided for mounting, Magnetic mounting also possible
